question: Compare total boxes scanned between June and July 2026
business_requirement: Compare business metrics between two distinct temporal intervals using explicit CASE expressions and grouping.
relevant_business_rules: Use CASE WHEN timestamp < split THEN 'Period 1' ELSE 'Period 2' END AS period_name
expected_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN si.retailer_scanned_at >= '2026-06-01 00:00:00' AND si.retailer_scanned_at < '2026-07-01 00:00:00' THEN 'June 2026' ELSE 'July 2026' END AS period_name, SUM(qpm.box_calculation_uom) AS total_boxes_scanned FROM sku_inventories si JOIN sku_qr_points_maps qpm ON si.sku_code = qpm.sku_code WHERE si.retailer_scanned_at >= '2026-06-01 00:00:00' AND si.retailer_scanned_at < '2026-08-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY period_name ORDER BY period_name;

question: Show top 5 retailers with their distributor and state names by box scans in July 2026
business_requirement: Resolve multi-table joins across retailers, distributors, and states projecting all requested human-readable entity attributes.
relevant_business_rules: Retailer join: users r ON r.user_role = 2
Distributor join: users d ON d.user_role = 4
State join: state s ON r.state_id = s.id (project s.sname)
No raw IDs without accompanying human-readable names
expected_sql: SELECT r.id AS retailer_id, r.name AS retailer_name, d.name AS distributor_name, s.sname AS state_name, SUM(qpm.box_calculation_uom) AS total_boxes_scanned FROM sku_inventories si JOIN sku_qr_points_maps qpm ON si.sku_code = qpm.sku_code JOIN users r ON si.status_retailer_id = r.id JOIN users d ON si.distributer_id = d.id JOIN state s ON r.state_id = s.id WHERE r.user_role = 2 AND d.user_role = 4 AND si.retailer_scanned_at >= '2026-07-01 00:00:00' AND si.retailer_scanned_at < '2026-08-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY r.id, r.name, d.name, s.sname ORDER BY total_boxes_scanned DESC LIMIT 5;

question: List all retailers with their total boxes scanned in July 2026
business_requirement: Calculate box quantity using authoritative JGH formula SUM(qpm.box_calculation_uom) for retailer.
relevant_business_rules: Box quantity calculation: SUM(qpm.box_calculation_uom) joined on sku_inventories.sku_code = qpm.sku_code
NEVER use COUNT(si.id) for box quantities
expected_sql: SELECT u.id AS retailer_id, u.name AS retailer_name, SUM(qpm.box_calculation_uom) AS total_boxes_scanned FROM sku_inventories si JOIN sku_qr_points_maps qpm ON si.sku_code = qpm.sku_code JOIN users u ON si.status_retailer_id = u.id WHERE u.user_role = 2 AND si.retailer_scanned_at >= '2026-07-01 00:00:00' AND si.retailer_scanned_at < '2026-08-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY u.id, u.name ORDER BY total_boxes_scanned DESC;
